tools.name: sensor_raw
tools.title: Raw I2C read
tools.description: Read 2 bytes from register 0x10 of the I2C device at 0x40 (raw counts, divide by 1.2 for lux).

tools.name: light_level
tools.title: Light level
tools.description: Ambient light in lux, computed from the sensor's raw 2-byte reading (raw / 1.2).
